title: Chapter 1011
text:
"Just as Black Star said, the time isn't ripe yet. Continuing to wait is what we should do," Sorokin said with a smile.

"Yes, we need more fresh blood." Manison nodded. He then glanced at the new Beyond Grade As present and made the mechanical host send a virtual emoji. A bubble smiley face appeared above his head.

Old man, you sure know how to act cute … This was the first thought that popped into Han Xiao's mind.

Hella could not help but turn to look at Han Xiao. She wanted to say something but stopped.

She did not expect these Beyond Grade As to have such a big topic when gathered together.

This meeting gradually turned into a magical direction. To Hella and the other new Beyond Grade As, the topic of these big shots was too profound. They could only listen silently and had no right to interrupt.

Will it be troublesome to talk about such a topic in our own territory … Hella was secretly worried.

Noticing Hella's gaze, Han Xiao gave her a reassuring look.

Ames noticed that the two of them were exchanging glances. She knocked Han Xiao with her force field and made him turn to look at her. She whispered, "You actually have the same purpose for holding this meeting, right? Otherwise, you wouldn't have let Manison use your territory to talk about such a big matter. "

"Everything is within my calculations." Han Xiao raised his brows.

Everyone argued for a while, and someone finally expressed their stance.

"Although we can't form an alliance, our circle does need a closer relationship," Kant said with a deep voice. "We need to communicate more frequently."

"The Flickering World is a suitable reason." A neutral peak Beyond Grade A slowly said, "In the past, due to the restrictions of our factions and regions, the interactions between us were limited. But now, everyone's organizations will enter the Flickering World, and this Star Field will become our platform for communication. To a certain extent, we will be free from the previous restrictions … Therefore, we need a bridge, a messenger. "

Hearing this, everyone subconsciously turned to look at Han Xiao.

In the explored universe, Beyond Grade A organizations could not expand as they wished. They were restricted by the advanced civilizations and various rules, which separated this level to a certain extent. In the future, everyone present would be able to enter the Flickering World, which was of great significance. Even if it was only the branches of the various Beyond Grade A organizations, it would still be able to cross the regional restrictions to a certain extent, making it convenient for all the Beyond Grade As to communicate and promote the unification of the class. This would allow a portion of everyone's strength to be completely united.

This required a bridge to form the information and resource transfer core of the Beyond Grade As in the Flickering World, binding everyone together like glue.

To be able to do this, one had to have a deep foundation in the Flickering World, and the Black Star Corps was the largest organization in the Flickering World other than the dynasty.

The best person to build the bridge was Black Star!

With more than seventy Beyond Grade As staring at a single person, even if they had no ill intentions, the pressure was still terrifying. Han Xiao took a deep breath and smiled.

"If you need it, I'm happy to do it."

In fact, this was one of Han Xiao's goals from the start. Although the process was a little different, he still got what he wanted.

All along, Han Xiao had let the Black Star Corps lay a foundation in the Flickering World, and part of the reason was to obtain this qualification.

Since he had become a member of the peak of individual strength, he had to face this problem. Although the butterfly effect caused by him changed the storyline, regardless of whether the World Tree War broke out before or after the Calamity of the Supers, he had to make plans for himself in advance.

If he became the link between the Calamity of the Supers, he would have more initiative.

As the peak of individual strength, unless he became the ruler, absolute loyalty to the collective strength did not exist. From the very beginning, the relationship between the two had been one of mutual benefit. Han Technician had never thought of being loyal to any organization. Even a child knew that eggs could not be placed in one basket. He had to prepare other escape routes for himself. Even if the chances of him being killed were very low, he would not ignore it.

The interests of different classes could not be truly unified. Unless one was willing to be used as a chess piece or become orange juice together, complicated problems could never be simplified.

The relationship between friend and foe often changed. Only class interests were the most reliable alliance.

"Your Excellency Black Star is very responsible."

Everyone nodded at Han Xiao, smiled, and looked away.

"I want to reach a tacit understanding with everyone." Manison looked around and said solemnly, "When that day comes, as long as someone calls for help, I hope everyone will respond."

"You'll see," Kasuyi said calmly.

Everyone nodded and reached a consensus.

Usually, they did not form alliances. Under normal circumstances, everyone would still fight for their own factions. Once the time was right, everyone would be willing to take action.

…

They talked about many things. After two days and two nights, the meeting officially ended. The Beyond Grade As bade farewell and left the Black Star Corps one after another.

Manison and Kasuyi walked together on the road to the dock, talking softly.

"The content of this meeting will definitely reach the ears of the three Universal Civilizations. You didn't hide it at all. Aren't you afraid of angering the Radiant Federation?" Kasuyi asked.

Manison smiled. "Even without this meeting, the fear will still exist. It's better to give them some pressure and increase our chips … With Black Star around, the Radiance can't leave me, and vice versa. The difference between factions restricts us and also restrains them."

"Anything is possible." Kasuyi shook his head. "When a tool has other thoughts, no matter how useful it is, it can be abandoned at any time."

"We're not tools." Manison's tone was calm. "Remember, we represent the peak of individual strength. Everyone is a treasure of this universe. Not only are we the embodiment of violence, but we're also a precious special gene bank. We represent the infinite possibilities of evolution. We're never small characters that can be trampled on by others … If you want to abandon us, you'll always have to pay the price."

"I understand. You're in such a hurry because you want to protect yourself." Kasuyi glanced at him. "Have you finally realized that your forces are too strong?"

Manison did not answer. He suddenly paused and sighed. "It's a pity … EsGod is gone. Although he's not on the same path, he's still somewhat useful. If he didn't stand on the opposite side of the three Universal Civilizations, who knows how much help he could have given us."

Kasuyi's tone was strange. "You know that his lifespan isn't long, right?"

"… What are you trying to say?"

"Hehe, nothing. It's just that … he definitely knows the problem of his lifespan better than anyone else." Kasuyi smiled.

…

After the meeting ended, the outside world gradually discovered an abnormal phenomenon.

All the Beyond Grade As who participated in the meeting were unexpectedly low-key, and no conflicts broke out.

Originally, with so many Beyond Grade As gathered, it was full of unstable factors. Everyone thought that it would affect the security of the Star Field, and there was an eighty percent chance that some Beyond Grade A battles would break out. However, from the beginning to the end, these big shots were very restrained and kept the Shattered Star Ring stable.

The entire universe was bewildered by this, and it caused a trend of speculation.

The source of these Beyond Grade As restraining themselves was definitely the meeting held by Black Star.

Just what did Black Star talk about to make so many Beyond Grade As behave?

Public opinion continued to spread, and finally, Han Xiao arranged for someone to reveal the inside information. Black Star had gathered all the foreign Beyond Grade As to represent the Shattered Star Ring. He asked everyone not to cause trouble and maintain the security of the Star Field.

As soon as the news spread, the Shattered Star Ring was in an uproar!

The first feeling of countless local galactic residents was that they were touched!

Look, Black Star is so responsible. In order to maintain security, he did not hesitate to take the risk to gather so many Beyond Grade As to his territory. He's simply a peacemaker with great love!

A Beyond Grade A who is willing to speak up for us is a responsible person!

Furthermore, Black Star's approach was very effective. So many Beyond Grade As were actually convinced and did not cause trouble. This was enough to show that Black Star had a huge influence.

It's our blessing to have such a person in the Star Field!

All of a sudden, Han Xiao's reputation in the Shattered Star Ring started to skyrocket.

After doing such a thing, countless galactic residents did not mind letting Black Star be the spokesperson of the Shattered Star Ring.

The power and identity of the leader of the Star Field were finally recognized by the galactic residents. His limelight was unparalleled, and the light of all the local organizations was suppressed.

To the Black Star Corps, this meeting was like a man-made promotional event. Only by doing things would they be able to increase their fame and status.

This meeting itself was also worth remembering. It was rare for so many Beyond Grade As to gather together, it was enough to go down in history.

On the internet, more and more people thought that this was the symbol of the Flickering Star Field and gave it a nickname … [Meeting of the Gods]!

…

You have received 2 Universe Legendary Points.

Universe Legendary Points: Spokesperson of the Shattered Star Ring — You have received the recognition of this Star Field. From now on, you have the right to be the spokesperson of the Shattered Star Ring!

Universe Legendary Points: Initiator of the Meeting of the Gods — After many years, many Beyond Grade As have gathered again. As the initiator of this event, you have gone down in history!

"Meeting of the Gods? Why not call it the Martial Arts Conference or the Mount Hua Sword Duel? "

In the Black Star Corps Headquarters, Han Xiao looked at the notification on the interface and could not help but curse.

Other than the name, he was quite satisfied with everything else. He had received two Universe Legendary Points.

Other than that, the mission given by the Red Empire to maintain the stability of the Star Field had also been completed. He had received billions of experience and a considerable amount of Red Empire Contribution Points.

Now that Hella had become a Beyond Grade A, he had the right to exchange for Esper Ultimate Knowledges from the dynasty. The more Hella owed him, the easier it would be to tie him to the army.

After completing the dynasty's mission, Uranril had specially called to praise him but did not mention anything about the conspiracy of the Beyond Grade As. However, they did not hide it, so it should be said that it was an open conspiracy.

Of course, the three Universal Civilizations would not be kept in the dark about this. Since they did not mention it, Han Xiao roughly understood the dynasty's attitude. They knew that it was useless to question their allies.

"There are no more problems in the Shattered Star Ring …" Han Xiao played with a pet robot the size of his palm and muttered to himself, "Now, all we have to do is wait for the dynasty to blow the horn of the era."

…

With so many Beyond Grade As setting an example, the other organizations did not cause any trouble. Everyone obediently waited for the opening of the Flickering World.

Han Xiao's actions had stabilized the situation in the Star Field. Everyone was focused on their preparations, and the days passed as they waited.

A few months passed, and the promised date finally arrived.

On this day, the dynasty officially announced the opening of the Flickering World. All Star Field Stargates leading to the Flickering World were activated!

At the same time, a notification popped up on Han Xiao's interface. The players he had not seen for a long time were finally online!
